verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Pipedream MCP as a remote MCP server that lets an agent make on-demand tool calls with managed auth. Nothing documents setting up scheduled, recurring, or background automations that run without an agent invoking them. The only related item is a count of '4 triggers' for one app, which does not show that users can configure autonomous background automations through this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
